pattern.zh: 选或不选：每个下标二选一
pattern.en: Pick or skip: two branches per index

when.zh: 元素互不相同、要列出所有子集时，最直接的写法是在每个下标上分两支：不选它、选它，走到末尾就是一个子集。LC 78 子集、LC 784 字母大小写全排列都是这个形状。
when.en: With distinct elements and every subset wanted, the plainest shape branches twice at each index (skip it, take it), and reaching the end yields one subset. LC 78 (Subsets) and LC 784 (Letter Case Permutation) have this shape.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n · 2^n) · 递归深度 O(n)

code.python:
def subsets(nums: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
    """Every subset of distinct nums."""
    res, path = [], []

    def dfs(i: int) -> None:
        if i == len(nums):
            res.append(path[:])  # one leaf per subset
            return
        dfs(i + 1)  # skip nums[i]
        path.append(nums[i])
        dfs(i + 1)  # take nums[i]
        path.pop()

    dfs(0)
    return res

pattern.zh: 组合：从 start 往后选，剪掉凑不满的分支
pattern.en: Combinations: choose from start on, prune short branches

when.zh: 只要固定大小 k 的组合：每层从 start 往后选，选够 k 个就记录；剩下的数不够凑满 k 个时直接停。LC 77 组合、LC 216 组合总和 III 都用这个剪枝。
when.en: For combinations of a fixed size k: each level picks from start onwards and records once k are chosen, and it stops as soon as too few numbers are left to finish. LC 77 (Combinations) and LC 216 (Combination Sum III) use this pruning.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(k · C(n, k)) · 递归深度 O(k)
complexity.en: O(k · C(n, k)) time · O(k) recursion depth

code.python:
def combine(n: int, k: int) -> list[list[int]]:
    """Every k-number combination of 1..n, each in increasing order."""
    res, path = [], []

    def dfs(start: int) -> None:
        if len(path) == k:
            res.append(path[:])
            return
        for x in range(start, n - (k - len(path)) + 2):  # leave room for the rest
            path.append(x)
            dfs(x + 1)
            path.pop()

    dfs(1)
    return res

pattern.zh: 组合可复选：递归时下标不加一
pattern.en: Combinations with reuse: recurse on the same index

when.zh: 同一个数可以选多次：递归时传 i 而不是 i + 1。先排序，候选数一旦超过剩余目标就 break，后面更大的数也不用试。LC 39 组合总和就是这一格。
when.en: When a number may be picked again: recurse with i instead of i + 1. Sort first so that once a candidate exceeds the remaining target the loop breaks, since every later one is larger. LC 39 (Combination Sum) is this cell.

complexity.zh: 时间指数级，取决于 target / min · 递归深度 O(target / min)
complexity.en: Exponential, governed by target / min · O(target / min) recursion depth

pattern.zh: 组合有重复：同层跳过相同值
pattern.en: Combinations with duplicates: skip equal values on a level

when.zh: 输入里有重复数字、每个只能用一次、答案不能重复：排序后同一层遇到和前一个相同的值就跳过，递归传 i + 1。LC 40 组合总和 II 就是这一格。
when.en: With repeated numbers, each used once and no duplicate answers: sort, skip a value equal to the previous one on the same level, and recurse with i + 1. LC 40 (Combination Sum II) is this cell.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n · 2^n) · 递归深度 O(n)

pattern.zh: 排列：used 数组标记已放的元素
pattern.en: Permutations: a used array marks placed elements

when.zh: 顺序不同算不同答案时，每层都从头扫一遍，跳过已经用过的位置。LC 46 全排列就是这一格；每层换一组候选（LC 17 电话号码的字母组合）也是同一个骨架。
when.en: When order matters, every level scans from the start and skips positions already used. LC 46 (Permutations) is this cell; LC 17 (Letter Combinations of a Phone Number) is the same skeleton with a new set of choices per level.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n · n!) · 空间 O(n)

code.python:
def permute(nums: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
    """Every ordering of distinct nums."""
    res, path, used = [], [], [False] * len(nums)

    def dfs() -> None:
        if len(path) == len(nums):
            res.append(path[:])
            return
        for i, x in enumerate(nums):
            if used[i]:
                continue  # each element appears once per ordering
            used[i] = True
            path.append(x)
            dfs()
            path.pop()
            used[i] = False

    dfs()
    return res

pattern.zh: 排列有重复：相同值按原顺序放
pattern.en: Permutations with duplicates: equal values in input order

when.zh: 输入有重复、排列不能重复：排序后规定相同的值只能按输入顺序放，前一个相同值还没用时跳过当前这个。LC 47 全排列 II、LC 1079 活字印刷都靠这一行去重。
when.en: With repeats in the input and no repeated orderings: sort, and let equal values be placed only in input order, skipping one while the equal value before it is unused. LC 47 (Permutations II) and LC 1079 (Letter Tile Possibilities) rely on that one line.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n · n!) · 空间 O(n)

code.python:
def permute_unique(nums: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
    """Every distinct ordering when nums has repeats."""
    nums = sorted(nums)
    res, path, used = [], [], [False] * len(nums)

    def dfs() -> None:
        if len(path) == len(nums):
            res.append(path[:])
            return
        for i in range(len(nums)):
            if used[i] or (i > 0 and nums[i] == nums[i - 1] and not used[i - 1]):
                continue  # equal values are placed in input order only
            used[i] = True
            path.append(nums[i])
            dfs()
            path.pop()
            used[i] = False

    dfs()
    return res

note.zh: 去掉 used 判断，每层都从全部元素里选，长度够 k 就记录，一共 n^k 个序列；LC 17 是每层换一组字母的同一形状。

when.zh: 每件物品只能选一次、容量有上限、要价值最大：倒序枚举容量，取 max。LC 1049 最后一块石头的重量 II 就是把石头重量同时当作重量和价值，求不超过总和一半的最大和。
when.en: Each item at most once, a capacity limit, the largest total value: run the capacity backwards and take the max. LC 1049 (Last Stone Weight II) is this with each stone as both weight and value, capped at half the total.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n × cap) · 空间 O(cap)

code.python:
def knapsack_01(weights: list[int], values: list[int], cap: int) -> int:
    """Best total value within capacity cap, each item at most once."""
    dp = [0] * (cap + 1)  # dp[c]: best value with capacity c
    for w, v in zip(weights, values):
        for c in range(cap, w - 1, -1):  # backwards: the item is used at most once
            dp[c] = max(dp[c], dp[c - w] + v)
    return dp[cap]

pattern.en: 0/1 knapsack: can the sum be reached

when.zh: 只问「能不能」、不问方案数或价值：状态换成布尔值，转移用 or。LC 416 分割等和子集先判断总和奇偶，再看能否凑出一半。
when.en: When the question is only whether a sum is reachable: boolean states combined with or. LC 416 (Partition Equal Subset Sum) checks the parity of the total, then asks whether half of it is reachable.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n × target) · 空间 O(target)

code.python:
def can_partition(nums: list[int]) -> bool:
    """Can nums be split into two groups with equal sums?"""
    total = sum(nums)
    if total % 2:
        return False
    target = total // 2
    dp = [True] + [False] * target  # dp[s]: some subset sums to s
    for x in nums:
        for s in range(target, x - 1, -1):  # backwards: x is used at most once
            dp[s] = dp[s] or dp[s - x]
    return dp[target]

pattern.en: Unbounded knapsack for the fewest items

when.zh: 物品可以无限取、要凑出的件数最少：正序枚举容量，dp 初值用「无穷大」，转移取 min(dp[s], dp[s - coin] + 1)。LC 322 零钱兑换和 LC 279 完全平方数都是这个形状。
when.en: Unlimited copies and the fewest items to hit the sum exactly: capacity forwards, start every state at infinity except dp[0], and take min(dp[s], dp[s - coin] + 1). LC 322 (Coin Change) and LC 279 (Perfect Squares) have this shape.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n × amount) · 空间 O(amount)

code.python:
def min_coins(coins: list[int], amount: int) -> int:
    """Fewest coins (each reusable) that sum to amount, or -1."""
    INF = amount + 1  # more coins than any answer can need
    dp = [0] + [INF] * amount  # dp[s]: fewest coins for sum s
    for coin in coins:
        for s in range(coin, amount + 1):  # forwards: the coin may be reused
            dp[s] = min(dp[s], dp[s - coin] + 1)
    return dp[amount] if dp[amount] < INF else -1

when.zh: 顺序不同算不同方案（1+2 和 2+1 是两种）：把「和」放在外层、物品放在内层，每个和都试一遍最后一步选谁。LC 377 组合总和 IV 名字叫组合，算的其实是排列数。
when.en: When different orders count as different ways (1+2 and 2+1 are two): sums in the outer loop, items in the inner loop, so every sum tries each possible last pick. LC 377 (Combination Sum IV) says combinations but counts orderings.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n × target) · 空间 O(target)

when.zh: 每件物品同时消耗两种资源（比如 0 的个数和 1 的个数）：状态加一维，两个容量都倒序。LC 474 一和零是求最多件数；LC 879 盈利计划是同样的两维再加计数。
when.en: When each item spends two resources at once (zeros and ones, say): add a dimension and run both capacities backwards. LC 474 (Ones and Zeroes) maximises the count; LC 879 (Profitable Schemes) counts with the same two dimensions.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(len × m × n) · 空间 O(m × n)
complexity.en: O(len × m × n) time · O(m × n) space

pattern.zh: 多重背包：二进制拆分成 0/1

when.zh: 第 i 种物品最多 counts[i] 件：按 1、2、4…件打包，剩下的再成一包，每包当一件 0/1 物品，复杂度从 O(cap × Σcnt) 降到 O(cap × Σlog cnt)。只适合求最大价值或可行性；计数会把同一件数数两次（5 = 1 + 2 + 2）。站内题没有直接考它，周赛和 OA 偶尔出现。
when.en: Item i has counts[i] copies: pack them in bundles of 1, 2, 4… plus the remainder and treat each bundle as one 0/1 item, cutting O(cap × Σcnt) to O(cap × Σlog cnt). It works for best value and feasibility; counting would count a quantity twice (5 = 1 + 2 + 2). No problem at this stop needs it directly; contests and OAs use it now and then.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(cap × Σ log cnt) · 空间 O(cap)
complexity.en: O(cap × Σ log cnt) time · O(cap) space

code.python:
def bounded_knapsack(weights: list[int], values: list[int], counts: list[int], cap: int) -> int:
    """Best value within cap when item i has counts[i] copies."""
    dp = [0] * (cap + 1)
    for w, v, cnt in zip(weights, values, counts):
        k = 1
        while cnt > 0:  # bundles of 1, 2, 4, ... copies, then the rest
            take = min(k, cnt)
            cnt -= take
            k *= 2
            for c in range(cap, take * w - 1, -1):  # each bundle is one 0/1 item
                dp[c] = max(dp[c], dp[c - take * w] + take * v)
    return dp[cap]
